description:
R2: properly-implemented PPO baselines for the wear-price problem.

Baselines (all trained on seeds >= 101, evaluated deterministically on test
seeds 1-5, 10-day episodes):

  B1  PPO-price            action = log10(mu_t) in [LOG_MU_LO, LOG_MU_HI]
                           (tanh-squashed Gaussian); dispatch = fast_dispatch
                           OPF with that wear price (identical to OPFAware).
                           Reward = -step_cost (the env reward).
  B2  Lagrangian PPO-price same action space; reward = -(step_cost + lam*c_t),
                           c_t = mean unit wear state, CMDP constraint
                           E_t[c_t] <= d, dual ascent on lam after every rollout.
  B3  End-to-end PPO       action = 5-D dispatch (gas, coal, nuclear, battery,
                           import); env enforces balance (unserved at VOLL).

PPO: clipped surrogate, GAE(lambda), separate value net, K epochs of minibatch
Adam updates per rollout, running obs normalisation, return-based reward
scaling, entropy bonus, grad-norm clipping, linear LR anneal.  Implemented in
torch (CPU, 1 thread).  Several environments are stepped sequentially in one
process so the network forward is batched.

Hyperparameters were chosen on *training/validation* seeds (201-203) only.

Run:  python -m twoclock.experiments.r2_ppo_eval            (full)
      python -m twoclock.experiments.r2_ppo_eval --quick    (smoke test)

notes.budgets_actual: B1 3 seeds x 150k steps; B2 (d=0.06) 1 seed x 100k; B3 1 seed x 100k (planned 300k, cut for wall-clock); B2 d=0.01 and PPO on peak were dropped for time. Peak references (blind/const/VG) were computed.
notes.hyperparams: PPO: 4 envs x 240 steps = 960/update, 10 epochs, minibatch 240, lr 3e-4 linear anneal, clip 0.2, gamma 0.99, GAE 0.95, vf 0.5, ent 0.0, grad-norm 0.5, 64x64 tanh actor/critic, init log_std -0.5, running obs norm + return-std reward scaling. Action log10(mu) = 3 + 3*tanh(z), mu in [1,1e6]. B2: c_t = mean unit wear state, lam += 5e4*(mean c - d) per update. Tried on validation seeds 201-203 (40k steps): lr 1e-3 (noisier, 6.97 at 40k), gamma 0.995/lam 0.98 (6.93 at 40k) vs default (6.78 at 40k); default kept. Test seeds never used for selection; curve checkpoints on test seeds are reported only.
notes.wear_end_mean_caveat: wear_end_mean measures wear at the final step; PPO policies lower mu near the episode end (rational under a finite horizon), so wear_episode_mean is the better wear statistic.
notes.wall_clock_caveat: Machine was shared with other python jobs; ms/step varied 2.5-10 ms, so wall-clock numbers are inflated/noisy.
